title: DSO: Direct Steering Optimization for Bias Mitigation

bias_targets.methodology: Measures 'Per-Occupation Bias' and 'Stereotype Gap' by evaluating whether model decisions in occupation identification, hiring, and coreference resolution tasks align with or contradict societal gender-occupation stereotypes. This is done using datasets with images or text featuring individuals of opposite perceived genders (e.g., SocialCounterfactuals, GenderBias-VL, SynthBias).
